en: Vintage divided‑back postcard printed in black and white with decorative floral borders. The front shows two images: on the left, a group of people standing on a wooden terrace in front of a wooden building set against a rocky mountainside, labeled in German and Hungarian as the Bethlen Grotte/Bethlen barlang with its altitude; on the right, a tall commemorative column or monument on a hilltop, labeled in German as "Millenium-Denkmal" and in Hungarian as "Millenium emlék szobor." Below is the bilingual city name "Kronstadt — Brassó." The reverse has handwritten text in German, a printed word "LEVELEZŐ-LAP" (Hungarian for postcard), postal cancellations, and a green Hungarian stamp denominated in fillér.
